g.text: Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.
arm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.
CHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched — they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.
ges the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values they were created with — this is not a cascade.
oject's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.
Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /proj
ject's credentials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the c
aller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.
tore a credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever make
s the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.
ret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another
project — and another member's personal secret — both read as 404.
elete a stored credential. HARD — the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocke
d when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every environmen
t naming it, and deletion must never wa…
e-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already runni
ng holds the old value — materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back — and there is
no safe way to replace it mid-run.
ys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records — `attempts` is on the single-run read.
d): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished — poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-run
.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.
essions.md): One entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts — read a transcript through the chat-session
ey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in th
e background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alre
warm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Determinist
t-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.
findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME — `occurrenceCount` and `stat
us` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.
ding.md): Hides a finding from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a d
ismissed finding that fires again stays `recurring`.
